content: Sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitors, including empagliflozin, dapagliflozin, and canagliflozin, have been shown to significantly reduce the risk of hospitalizations due to heart failure and improve cardiovascular outcomes in patients with type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease. Clinical trials, such as EMPEROR-Preserved and DELIVER, have demonstrated that these medications reduce the incidence of heart failure-related events and mortality rates, regardless of whether the patient has diabetes. This evidence highlights the broad therapeutic benefits of SGLT2 inhibitors in managing heart failure.
